DESIGN sniped from the christofuturism universe at Gary's direction 2026-08-11 while standing up the pcs.wiki device canon. What crossed over is the design, carried in the invariants: clear champagne acetate, slim old-gold inlay, faint smoke-gold tint with the eyes visible, modern wayfarer shape. What did NOT cross over is the art: the source plates are photoreal and photoreal is a rejected pole here, so passing one as a render reference would have pulled every image off-register. New masters were shot in warm-editorial ink-and-wash; the source plates are kept under reference/spatial-lenses/lineage/ as the design record and are never passed to a generator.
